design_choices: CLI uses pnl_ledger schema as-is (status=open instead of pending). pnl_ledger.settle_bet already handles the open->won/lost/push transition and bankroll updates atomically.

settle_bets.py keeps legacy CLI (cycle 68 bet-log mode) intact; the new R16_E7 flow is opt-in via --from-quarter-box. New helper sum_quarter_box(game_id) sums q1-q4 because each quarter_box JSON is per-quarter (max 12 min per row), not cumulative.
Stake cap defaults to 5% of 000 bankroll; configurable via --bankroll / --max-pct. Cap enforced BEFORE ledger write and before slate match, so a bad placement never touches the ledger.
Idempotency check inspects ledger for an OPEN row with same (player, stat, side, book, line). Avoids accidental double-recording on retried CLI invocations. Override via --allow-duplicate.

Slate validation defaults to data/cache/probe_R15_tonight_slate_bets.json. Match tolerance: name_key + lower(stat) + upper(side) + canonical(book) + |line-line|<=0.01. Bypassable with --no-slate-validate for off-slate manual bets.
Copy-paste block prints book in uppercase + UNAFFECTED ODDS SIGN + payout math + Bet ID line, ready to mirror onto FanDuel/Bovada/Pinnacle UI.
show_bet.py supports both full UUID and unique prefix (>=4 chars) lookup. Returns exit 0 on hit, 1 on no match, 2 on ambiguous prefix.
